CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Consulting Services Agreement is entered into between Palo Robotics
Inc. ("Consultant") and Timberline Builders LLC ("Client").

1. Scope of Work. Consultant shall provide process-automation consulting
as described in Exhibit A, including a current-state assessment and a
90-day implementation roadmap.

2. Fees. Client shall pay Consultant $18,500 upon execution and $18,500
upon delivery of the final roadmap document.

3. Independent Contractor. Consultant is an independent contractor and not
an employee, agent, or partner of Client for any purpose.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the other's confidential
information secret and shall not disclose it to any third party without
prior written consent, except as required by law.

5. Limitation of Liability. Neither party's aggregate liability under this
Agreement shall exceed the total fees paid in the twelve months preceding
the claim.

6. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of
California.
